{"text":"ItemID: 1; Title: Fire TV Stick 4K streaming device with Alexa Voice Remote (includes TV controls) | Dolby Vision; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I already have a Fire TV Stick 4K Max, so this would duplicate my streaming setup.
ItemID: 2; Title: Echo Dot (3rd Gen, 2018 release) - Smart speaker with Alexa - Charcoal; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My newer Echo Dot already fills this role, and I have no immediate need for another.
ItemID: 3; Title: Echo Show 5 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- Smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Charcoal; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I recently added a stand for my second-generation Show 5 and would keep using that setup.
ItemID: 4; Title: Amazon Smart Plug, for home automation, Works with Alexa - A Certified for Humans Device; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try controlling a lamp through my existing Echo devices; this adds a useful function to my setup.
ItemID: 5; Title: Samsung SSD 860 EVO 4TB 2.5 Inch SATA III Internal SSD (MZ-76E4T0B/AM); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I use external storage, and I do not currently have an internal drive upgrade planned.
ItemID: 6; Title: TOZO T10 Bluetooth 5.3 Wireless Earbuds with Wireless Charging Case IPX8 Waterproof Stereo Headphones in Ear Built in Mic Headset Premium Sound with Deep Bass for Sport White (2022 Upgraded); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Wireless earbuds are not something I am looking for right now; my recent needs center on home and computer equipment.
ItemID: 7; Title: Fire TV Stick streaming device with Alexa built in, includes Alexa Voice Remote, HD, latest release; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My existing 4K Max already handles streaming, so an HD stick adds little for me.
ItemID: 8; Title: Echo Show 8 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- HD smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Sandstone; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A larger screen is interesting, but I am currently using my Show 5 and do not need another display.
ItemID: 9; Title: WD 2TB Elements Portable HDD, External Hard Drive, USB 3.0 for PC & Mac, Plug and Play Ready - WDBU6Y0020BBK-WESN; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would use a portable drive for a separate backup; it complements my existing desktop WD drive.
ItemID: 10; Title: Fire HD 10 Tablet with Alexa Hands-Free, 10.1" 1080p Full HD Display, 32 GB, Marine Blue (Previous Generation - 7th); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I do not have a specific tablet need, and Alexa support alone would not persuade me to add this older device."}
